svg.text: OPTION 4 - GROUND FLOOR (phase 1), corrected to the 16'9" inside width
2 bedrooms, living + dining, kitchen with a door to a 137 sqft garden, store, 3 toilets in the house. Straight stair along the west wall with cupboards under it.
ROAD / GATE (NORTH) on the left. Top edge = EAST neighbour house (our new 9" wall). Bottom edge = WEST apartment (existing wall). Right = BACK (existing wall).

Plot 106' x 21' (20' at back). East: 6" compound wall + 1'3" setback. West: 1' setback from the apartment wall. Outer walls 9", partitions 6". Inside width 16'9" at the front, 15'9" at the back. Positions are feet from the front boundary.
west setback 1' from the apartment wall
NEEM TREE: trunk 3'6" from road, 7'6" from west,
leans in to ~8'. Slab above starts at 14'.
EXTERNAL STAIR to hall (phase 2): 4' wide, 18 x 7"
INTERNAL STAIR 3'3" wide: 9 + 9 risers x 7", treads 10"
cupboards under flight 1 (dining side), tall store under flight 2 (passage side)
L counter on east + back wall, door to garden
PASSAGE 3'3" (full height under arrival landing at the back)
high windows on the east wall (sill 7'), above the setback
Black squares = RCC columns in the side walls (6 per side). Beams span the 16'9". The hall above is column-free.
